items.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Fee Sheet drug-inventory lookup (DrugSalesService::sellDrug) that interpolates the prod[N][warehouse] POST field into an ORDER BY clause. items.title: Perl 未授权 CWE-191
items.description: JSON::XS versions from 4.0_00 before 4.05 for Perl corrupt the incremental buffer length by chopping past its end in incr_skip after a top-level number. items.title: Perl 未授权 释放后重用(UAF)

With allow_tags, an object's FREEZE method is called in list context and each returned value is encoded through a saved Perl stack pointer.

items.title: Perl 未授权 CWE-401
items.description: JSON::XS versions before 4.05 for Perl leak the decoded key of an object rejected for a missing colon in decode_hv. A process that keeps running after a failed decode retains one key per rejected document, with its size chosen by the sender. Repeated requests exhaust process memory.
